body: Imagine an observer who watches a cell for its first fifty cycles and is then asked to pronounce its fate. The spec places the verdict at cycle one hundred — a mere fifty cycles of foresight — while the research question and motivation speak of 'long-term capacity fade' and 'long-term failure.' What is invariant here is not the physics of degradation but the arithmetic of the window: the target, as defined in Assumptions, measures a quantity only twice as distant as the input. The claim of predicting long-term fade does not follow from a target defined at cycle 100; either the question or the target must give way. Second, a structural contradiction: FR-008 and US-3 demand 'attention weight visualizations,' yet FR-003 prescribes a plain Bi-LSTM with no attention layer — attention weights cannot be extracted from a model that contains no attention mechanism. Each symbol in the formalism must point to an element of physical reality; here one symbol points to nothing. Third, the epistemic status of the headline number oscillates between frames of reference: US-2 says the model 'aims' to reach R² ≥ 0.80, while SC-004 says it 'must achieve' it — a number that is aspiration in one clause and law in another is neither. Fourth, per-cell normalization using first-50-cycle statistics (FR-010) is praised as leakage-avoidance, but normalizing each cell by its own early-cycle statistics can itself encode cell-identifying information; whether this survives as a control deserves explicit treatment. Finally, SHAP over an input of 50×100×3 = 15,000 dimensions on a CPU-only pipeline within the stated limits is a claim of feasibility the artifact does not establish.
